lines.l: Hard-workin' Saginaw fisherman, too many times he came home with too little pain.
I loved a girl in Saginaw, Michigan, the daughter of a wealthy, wealthy man.
But he called me that son of a Saginaw fisherman.
And not good enough to claim his daughter's hand
Now I'm up here in Alaska
Looking around for gold
Like a crazy fool I'm a-digging
In this frozen grounds of cold
But with each new day
I pray I'll strike it rich and then
I'll go back home and claim my love in Saginaw, Michigan
I wrote my love in Saginaw, Michigan
I said, honey, I'm coming home, please wait for me
And you can tell your dad, I'm coming back a richer man
I hit the biggest track in Klondike history
Her dad met me in Saginaw, Michigan
He gave me a great big party with champagne
Then he said, son, you're a wise, young, ambitious man
Will you sell your father and a lawyer upon that claim
Now he's up there in Alaska
Digging in the cold, cold ground
The greedy fool is looking for the gold I've ever found
It serves him right and no one here is missing him
Least of all the newlyweds of Saginaw, Michigan
With the happiest man and wife in Saginaw, Michigan
From the very heart of Manhattan in New York City
The Real Country Sound
